messages:
Ava Martinez: Quick thread to coordinate the v1->v2 sunset comms and migration docs. Legal wants final copy 10 days before public annoucement. We need: main migration guide, quick-start snippets (TS/Py), anchor/redirect list, rollback steps, and a short FAQ about model aliasing. Who volunteers?
Riley Park: I'll own the migration guide skeleton and the rollback section. Will include canary plan and metrics to watch.
Devon Shaw: I'll update all SDK samples. I will add both 'minimal change' and 'full v2 style' examples for Node and Python. ETA Tue.
Maya Singh: I'll run a link audit and produce the redirect CSV. Also will coordinate with infra on TTL & 302 vs 410 timing.
Ava Martinez: Please add a short paragraph on model swaps and aliasing — mention fallback alias 'rw-compat-small' and fallback policy.
Riley Park: Adding monitoring thresholds: increase in 4xx errors by 0.4% for 10m or streaming frame drops >1% triggers rollback.
Devon Shaw: Snippet examples I'll add to PR:
```js
// v1 (old SDK)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'legacy-chat', prompt: 'hi' })
// v2 (new SDK)
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood.Client({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN })
const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-chat', input: 'hi' })
```
Maya Singh: Found 12 anchors pointing to /docs/v1/reference. I'll compile CSV with old_path,new_path,owner,notes. Infra-Bot: Redirect service recommends 302 until final day, then switch to 410. Use short TTL during testing.
Devon Shaw: Also adding streaming note: v1 streamed newline-delimited JSON objects; v2 streams framed events with event type header. Will include sample consumer shim.
Ava Martinez: Legal-Review, can you paste the exact approved deprecation blurb here so we copy verbatim?
Legal-Review: "Deprecated endpoints will stop accepting requests after 2025-05-10 and will return HTTP 410 with guidance to /docs/migration."
Riley Park: I've added a one-line rollback command in the runbook: revert docs deploy, flip redirect table to previous CSV version, and re-open the v1 flag. Include who to ping on call.
Docs-Bot: Reminder: label PRs with 'deprecation' and attach smoke test checklist. Meeting scheduled: #docs-review Mon 10:00 PT for signoff.
Maya Singh: Will submit redirect CSV in PR. Also tagging infra for a dry-run redirect verification.
Devon Shaw: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/429 — includes snippets and migration-guide-draft. Feedback welcome.
Ava Martinez: Great work. We'll gate the public announcement on successful smoke tests and legal final signoff. If anything blocks, hold the announcement and notify #product immediately.
